supportCaveat: Support depends on JDK vendor and entitlement. Oracle JDK 17 Premier Support ended September 2026; Extended Support runs through September 2029 for entitled customers.

evidence.details: Compiler plugin source/target and maven.compiler.source/target properties specify 17.

Java 27 is the latest feature release; Java 25 is the latest LTS.
